Hello!

I'm not an expert in YNAB but I've been using it for a long time now. It really has gotten my wife and I back on track financially. I just wanted to post a few tips that I use to make YNAB easier.

  1. If your bank allows for text notifications, or app notifications use them! I use Chase for banking and it works incredibly well. I slide my card, less than 2 seconds later, Chase pops up and gives me the transaction details, I open the app and enter them. It takes me less than 15-20 seconds to enter a transaction this way.

  2. My wife and I decided a while ago that only one of us would enter transactions. We were both trying to enter each-others, and both forgetting to on occasion. So I put it on myself to enter all of them myself.

  3. Don't stress if YNAB and your Checking account are out of sync by a small amount of money. This sometimes happens because of restaurant tips that weren't entered correctly, or a forgotten transactions. Don't lose hope! I simply add a transaction into Checking, mark the Payee as "YNAB" charge it to my savings category, and in the memo I write "YNAB / Checking Account Reconcilliation". Usually I have to do this to the tune of ~10 dollars every month. Much easier than freaking out and searching through bank statements for hours.

  4. Use the Import feature. I download bank statements in QIF format for a specified date range every week when we get paid, and then go through and approve everything that I already entered. This usually catches the 1-2 or transactions that slip by.

  5. Watch the YNAB videos on Youtube - they have OUTSTANDING customer training.

Good luck voaters.

I must say, the game is really fun! Although it doesn't have offline progress as many of today's incremental games do, it's really fun!  

  • The graphics and the animations are cool, pretty and looks like much effort was put into it.
  • The interface is really sleek, although it can be complicated at the first time, flashing buttons will guide your way.
  • It has an AdVenture Capitalist feeling for me (buying buildings, running them by yourself, then buying managers so they run them for you, and then profit) *I like the addition of weapons, armors and the pets, too bad the pets don't show up from time to time, but they add to the random chat bubbles that come from the hero! :D
  • The random chat bubbles, oh they are fun to read. :D Also, try clicking your hero a few times... or more. :D
  • The news are really helpful, they give discounts, more profit from your buildings, investment discounts etc.
  • The "investment" part it really fun, it has a chance to fail, but if it doesn't you can multiply your invested money with them!
  • Joining guilds helps you to over time gain more and more from your buildings just by them producing the items/coins you need.
  • Your hero also makes levels, and at some levels you will change class, that will result in more coins, your buildings will work faster, you will get more fame etc.

 

The game is really fun. And I can only imagine how fun it'll be after an offline progressions system and even more things to do! Definitely try it out!
